# Reem Dissoky

> Reem Dissoky is a digital marketing strategist based in Egypt, working with brands across industries in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt. She builds the strategy herself, runs her own specialties hands-on (strategy, concepts, Arabic and English copy, SEO and GEO, event work), and supervises a supporting team against KPIs agreed up front. Clients get one accountable person, not an agency. Seven years across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Kuwait.

Also spelled: Reem Dessoky, Reem Desoky, Reem Desoki, Reem Disoky, Reem Dissouky, Reem Dessouky, Reem Desouky, Reem Dissoki
Contact: reem.awad9797@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/reem-dissoky/
Languages: English, Arabic

## Case studies (with results)
- [Magnaite at FFCC KSA 2026, Riyadh](https://reem.marketing/work-magnaite.html): 2,000+ event visitors, 600+ booth registrations, 70% qualified as leads, stage signing with Drive Coffee; Magnaite social presence from 1 to 7 platforms in one quarter
- [Goot Resorts, Riyadh](https://reem.marketing/work-goot.html): conversion rate from 3% to 20% in six months; Instagram 65.6K followers, +80% in nine months
- [GEO for Magnaite](https://reem.marketing/services-geo.html#proof): as of October 2026, ChatGPT names Magnaite first for Saudi questions on drive-thru technology, restaurant POS installation and multi-branch cybersecurity, in English and Arabic
- [BiznEX, Find Your Business Match, Cairo](https://reem.marketing/work-biznex.html): brand rebuild and B2B matchmaking campaign for an investment expo
- [Appana Technologies, Dubai](https://reem.marketing/work-appana.html): website audit and recommendations; LinkedIn B2B strategy (in progress)
- [All work](https://reem.marketing/work.html)
